facts.text: The Peninsula Paris is at 19 Avenue Kleber in the 16th arrondissement of Paris.
facts.excerpt: The Peninsula Paris, 19 Avenue Kléber Paris, France, 75116

facts.text: The hotel is steps away from the Arc de Triomphe.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is literally steps away from the Arc de Triomphe

facts.text: The building originally opened in 1908 and spent decades as the Hotel Majestic.
facts.excerpt: Originally opened in 1908, the building spent decades as the Hôtel Majestic

facts.text: A four-year restoration turned the building into the Peninsula brand's first European hotel in 2014.
facts.excerpt: a four-year restoration transformed it into the Peninsula brand's first European outpost in 2014

facts.text: The hotel holds Palace status, a tier above five-star in France.
facts.excerpt: earning Palace-grade status—one tier above five-star—ever since

facts.text: More than 80 works of art, curated by Hong Kong-based Sabrina Fung Fine Arts, are displayed throughout the hotel.
facts.excerpt: More than 80 works of art, curated by Hong Kong–based Sabrina Fung Fine Arts, thread through the hotel

facts.text: Rooms pair Haussmannian character with sitting areas and walk-in dressing rooms.
facts.excerpt: Apartment-like rooms pair Haussmannian character with sitting areas, walk-in dressing rooms and seamless technology steps from the Arc de Triomphe

facts.text: The Rooftop Eiffel Suite has a private rooftop garden with Eiffel Tower views.
facts.excerpt: Perched above Paris, this unique suite unveils a private rooftop garden and breathtaking Eiffel Tower views

facts.text: The rooftop restaurant L'Oiseau Blanc has held two Michelin stars since 2021, renewed in 2026.
facts.excerpt: Two Michelin Stars since 2021, renewed in 2026

facts.text: L'Oiseau Blanc is aviation-themed, honouring Charles Nungesser and Francois Coli, who attempted to cross the Atlantic in 1927 from Le Bourget.
facts.excerpt: flying aces Charles Nungesser and François Coli who attempted to cross the Atlantic in 1927 from Le Bourget

facts.text: L'Oiseau Blanc is led by Chef David Bizet.
facts.excerpt: Under the direction of Chef David Bizet

facts.text: LiLi, the Cantonese restaurant, hosts live traditional Chinese music Thursday through Saturday.
facts.excerpt: LiLi, the Cantonese restaurant, hosts live traditional Chinese music Thursday through Saturday.

facts.text: Bar Kleber's oak paneling and gilded moldings recall the building's earlier life as the Majestic.
facts.excerpt: Bar Kléber's oak paneling and gilded moldings recall the building's earlier life as the Majestic

facts.text: The Peninsula Spa blends French beauty with Asian treatment traditions.
facts.excerpt: Subtly blending the elegance of French beauty with the ancient traditions of Asian treatments

facts.text: The pool is only available to hotel guests and members of The Peninsula Spa.
facts.excerpt: The pool is only available to hotel guests and members of The Peninsula Spa.

facts.text: Children must be accompanied by a parent or guardian when using the pool.
facts.excerpt: All children must be accompanied by a parent or guardian when using the pool.

facts.text: Two fitness rooms were fully renovated in March 2025 with Technogym equipment.
facts.excerpt: two fitness rooms—fully renovated in March 2025—offer state-of-the-art Technogym equipment

facts.text: The Morning Rise experience is a gentle run with a certified coach past Paris landmarks from the Eiffel Tower to Pont Alexandre III.
facts.excerpt: Set off on a gentle run with a certified coach, passing iconic Paris landmarks from the Eiffel Tower to Pont Alexandre III

facts.text: The Saturday morning yoga class is complimentary for hotel guests with advance booking through the Spa.
facts.excerpt: This experience is complimentary for all our hotel guests and requires advance booking with the Spa.

facts.text: The hotel's car fleet includes customised Peninsula Edition MINI Cooper S Clubmans and BMW 7 Series.
facts.excerpt: customised Peninsula Edition MINI Cooper S Clubmans or BMW 7 Series

facts.text: The hotel calls The Peninsula Spa the largest hotel spa in Paris.
facts.excerpt: The Peninsula Spa, the largest hotel spa in Paris

facts.text: La Terrasse Kleber is billed as the largest covered terrace in the capital.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to the largest covered terrace in the capital.

facts.text: The hotel has 200 rooms including 93 suites.
facts.excerpt: The Peninsula Paris’ 200 rooms, including 93 suites

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says the hotel has 200 rooms and 86 suites.
facts.excerpt: The hotel's 200 rooms and 86 suites are among the most spacious in Paris

contradictions.note: Official rooms page says 93 suites; Conde Nast Traveler says 86 suites
